name: Medici: Sealed Ledgers (revised)
summary: Players take turns as the active seat and set the size of a lot of 1 to 3 revealed goods cards. Everyone then makes a sealed bid for the lot. Each day pays florins for the most valuable ships, for majorities in each good and for a secret favoured good. Most florins after 6N rounds wins.

player.meaning: The player's money and score. Only the owner sees it until the end.
The secret favoured good (Grain, Cloth, Spice or Dye), dealt from favour_pool before round 1.
Cards loaded on the ship today, each written as Good-Value, for example Spice-3.
Sum of the card values on the ship today.
Number of cards on the ship today, at most 5.
Number of cards of the player's favoured good on the ship today. It is kept private because it would reveal the favoured good.
Cumulative Grain cards won over the whole game.
Cumulative Cloth cards won over the whole game.
Cumulative Spice cards won over the whole game.
Cumulative Dye cards won over the whole game.
This round's sealed bid after voiding. It is gathered by poll and announced afterwards.

game.meaning: Favour tiles: the 4 goods once each for N of 3 or 4, twice each for N of 5 or 6.
The 48 cards, 12 per good with values 0,1,1,2,2,3,3,3,4,4,5,5, rebuilt and shuffled at each day start.
The 3 cards revealed this round, in order.
1, 2 or 3, chosen by the active seat.
Cards discarded for the rest of the day: unused revealed cards and unsold lots.
Number of players who made high_bid.
Seat that bought the lot this round, or 0 for no sale.
Highest ship value at day end.
Highest ship value strictly below top_value at day end, or 0 if there is none.
Highest cumulative Grain count at day end.
Highest cumulative Cloth count at day end.
Highest cumulative Spice count at day end.
Highest cumulative Dye count at day end.

setup: Seat N players (3 to 6) in seats 1..N.
Each player's florins are set to 40, visible only to that player.
Each player's ship is set empty: ship_cards [], ship_value 0, ship_count 0, ship_favoured 0.
Each player's grain_count, cloth_count, spice_count and dye_count are set to 0.
favour_pool is built as Grain, Cloth, Spice and Dye once each if N is 3 or 4, or twice each (8 tiles) if N is 5 or 6.
One tile is drawn at random from favour_pool into each player's favoured_good and removed from favour_pool.

round.effect: round += 1; active_seat = ((round-1) mod N)+1; winner_seat = 0; high_bid = 0; high_count = 0; every player's bid = 0.
when round mod 2N = 1: deck is set to all 48 cards (Grain, Cloth, Spice and Dye, each with values 0,1,1,2,2,3,3,3,4,4,5,5); discard = []. Cards are drawn at random, so the deck is shuffled.
when round mod 2N = 1: every player's ship_cards = [], ship_value = 0, ship_count = 0, ship_favoured = 0. Florins and cumulative good counts are kept.
revealed = []; draw 3 cards at random from deck, in order, appending each to revealed and removing it from deck. Announce revealed cards 1, 2 and 3 to everyone.
lot = the first lot_size cards of revealed; the remaining revealed cards are appended to discard; revealed = []. Announce the lot.
Each player is sent their own florins, favoured_good and ship_favoured, plus the public state.

round.answer: a whole number from 0 to your current florins (0 = pass)
round.effect: Each player's bid = the answer; nobody sees any bid until all are in.
For each player: if ship_count + lot_size > 5 then bid = 0.
high_bid = the maximum bid over all players; high_count = the number of players whose bid = high_bid.

when high_bid > 0 and high_count = 1: winner_seat = the seat whose bid = high_bid; that player's florins -= bid (paid to the bank, leaving the game). Otherwise winner_seat = 0, the lot is appended to discard, and nobody pays.

when winner_seat > 0: the lot cards are appended to the winner's ship_cards; ship_value += sum of the lot values; ship_count += lot_size; ship_favoured += the number of lot cards whose good = favoured_good; grain_count, cloth_count, spice_count and dye_count each += the number of lot cards of that good; lot = [].
Announce the lot, every player's bid, and winner_seat with price high_bid, or 'no sale'.
when round mod 2N = 0: top_value = the maximum ship_value over all players; second_value = the maximum ship_value among players whose ship_value < top_value, or 0 if there is none.
when round mod 2N = 0: each player with ship_value = top_value and top_value > 0 gains 10 florins; each player with ship_value = second_value and second_value > 0 gains 5 florins.

when round mod 2N = 0: grain_max, cloth_max, spice_max and dye_max = the maximum of that cumulative count over all players; for each good, each player whose count = that max, when the max >= 1, gains 4 florins.
when round mod 2N = 0: each player's florins += 3 * ship_favoured.
when round mod 2N = 0: announce the day-end ship values and cumulative good counts. Florins and favoured goods are not shown.
If round = 6N the game ends; otherwise the next round begins.

ending.decided_by: Each player's standing is their florins after round 6N. The most florins wins, and players tied for the most share the win (a draw).

rules.text: When the game starts, then each player has 40 florins visible only to themselves, an empty ship (ship_value 0, ship_count 0) and 0 of each cumulative good count.

When N is 3 or 4, then the favour pool is Grain, Cloth, Spice and Dye once each; when N is 5 or 6, then it is each good twice (8 tiles). Each player is dealt one tile at random as a secret favoured_good.
When the deck is built, then it has 48 cards: 12 per good with values 0,1,1,2,2,3,3,3,4,4,5,5 (sum 33 per good).
When round is r, then the active seat is ((r-1) mod N)+1.
When round mod 2N = 1, then the deck is rebuilt as all 48 cards and shuffled, and every ship_value, ship_count and ship_favoured is set to 0, while florins and cumulative counts are kept.
When a round begins, then 3 cards are drawn from the deck and revealed to everyone in order as revealed cards 1, 2 and 3.
When the active seat chooses lot size k (1, 2 or 3), then the lot is the first k revealed cards and the other 3-k revealed cards are discarded for the day.
When bids are made, then every player, the active seat included, bids at the same time a whole number from 0 to their current florins, and 0 is a pass.
When a player's ship_count plus lot_size exceeds 5 (for example ship_count 4 and lot_size 2), then that player's bid becomes 0.
When the highest bid is above 0 and exactly one player made it, then that player pays their bid to the bank, the florins leave the game, and that player wins the lot.
When all bids are 0, or two or more players tie for the highest bid, then the lot is discarded, nobody pays and there is no sale.

When a player wins a lot, then their ship_value increases by the sum of the lot values, their ship_count by the lot size, their ship_favoured by the number of lot cards of their favoured good, and each cumulative good count by the number of lot cards of that good.
When a round's auction ends, then the lot, every bid, and the winner and price (or 'no sale') are announced to everyone.
When round mod 2N = 0, then every player whose ship_value equals the highest ship_value gains 10 florins, if that value is above 0.
When round mod 2N = 0, then every player whose ship_value equals the highest ship_value strictly below the top gains 5 florins, if that value is above 0.
When round mod 2N = 0, then for each of the four goods, every player whose cumulative count equals the highest count of that good gains 4 florins, if that count is at least 1.
When round mod 2N = 0, then each player gains 3 florins per card of their favoured good on their ship (3 * ship_favoured).
When round = 6N (18 with 3 players, 24 with 4, 30 with 5, 36 with 6), then the game ends after that round's day-end payouts.
When the game ends, then the player with the most florins wins, and players tied for the most share the win.

offers.question: Lot size
offers.options: 1, 2 or 3, always (even if the active seat's own ship could not hold the lot).

offers.question: Sealed bid
offers.who: every seat at the same time
offers.options: any whole number from 0 to that seat's current florins; a seat with 0 florins may only bid 0. A seat whose ship cannot hold the lot may still bid, but the bid is voided to 0.

choices.why: The designer suggests 4. Three is the minimum where sealed bids face more than one rival and majorities can be contested. Above 6, the favour pool and the day length would no longer fit the 48-card deck.
The source states there is no talk phase. The strategy lies in reading public bids, ships and counts to infer others' florins and favoured goods.

choices.what: Cards encoded as Good-Value text in lists
choices.why: This lets drawing, lots, ships and discards be list operations, and lets values and goods be counted arithmetically.

choices.what: Card value distribution given as one count per value (value_0_cards_per_good ... value_5_cards_per_good)
choices.why: Parameters must be single numbers, so the list 0,1,1,2,2,3,3,3,4,4,5,5 is written as how many cards of each value each good has.

choices.what: ship_favoured kept visible only to its owner (ally)
choices.why: Making it public would reveal the favoured good, which the rules keep secret until the end.

choices.what: Bids stored in a public attribute filled by a poll
choices.why: Nobody sees a bid until all are in, and the rules make all bids public at the announcement.

simplifications.what: Shuffling the deck is done as drawing cards at random from the deck list
simplifications.why: The engine has no shuffle operation; random draws are equivalent and seeded.

simplifications.what: Day-start and day-end steps run every round but carry a 'when round mod 2N' condition
simplifications.why: The step list is flat; each conditional step is a single conditioned update, not an alternative block.
